title: Classification of BCI-EEG Based on Augmented Covariance Matrix
verified_mechanism: Delay embedding gives an SPD augmented covariance with spatial and lagged dependence. The paper relates delay/order to autoregression and dynamical reconstruction, and studies grid search and dynamical parameter estimation.
adaptation: We retain two copies and compare lag4 against previous lag1 at exactly the same dimension. We do not reproduce their classifiers, datasets or parameter search.

title: Covariance Matrix Estimation in Time Series
verified_mechanism: Studies covariance and autocovariance estimation for temporally dependent observations, including Toeplitz structure and tapering. Serial dependence changes covariance estimation; arbitrary lag matrices are not automatically positive definite.
adaptation: Our zero-padded shift Gram is a finite-sample PSD construction with equal diagonal blocks, then OAS regularization. This particular implementation is an adaptation, not the full estimator from the review.

authors: David Hallac; Sagar Vare; Stephen Boyd; Jure Leskovec
title: Toeplitz Inverse Covariance-Based Clustering of Multivariate Time Series Data
verified_mechanism: TICC models multivariate subsequences with block-Toeplitz inverse covariance networks and jointly learns segmentation and clusters. Demonstrated outside neuroscience on automobile sensor data.
adaptation: Motivates stationary temporal structure. Full TICC would alter the baseline, so no clustering, graphical lasso, state transition penalty or fitted cluster reference is introduced.

authors: Mohamed E. Hussein; Marwan Torki; Mohammad A. Gowayyed; Motaz El-Saban
title: Human Action Recognition Using a Temporal Hierarchy of Covariance Descriptors on 3D Joint Locations
verified_mechanism: Uses covariances of joint locations and a hierarchy of subsequence covariance descriptors to preserve temporal information in human action recognition.
adaptation: Use only a fixed first/second-half level, assembled into one block-diagonal SPD matrix. This packing, OAS and unchanged Riemannian classifier are our adaptation; the full original hierarchy/classifier is not reproduced.

authors: Andres Sanin; Conrad Sanderson; Mehrtash T. Harandi; Brian C. Lovell
title: Spatio-Temporal Covariance Descriptors for Action and Gesture Recognition
verified_mechanism: Uses spatio-temporal covariance descriptors, a weighted Riemannian projection and boosting for action/gesture recognition. Shows covariance descriptors need not be restricted to raw sensor amplitudes.
adaptation: Contextual cross-domain evidence. Its projection and boosting would change the classifier; neither is copied. No direct claim that its video features are suitable EEG features.

title: Nonparametric Spectral Analysis of Multivariate Time Series
verified_mechanism: Reviews multivariate spectral density, cross-spectra, smoothing and positive-definite estimation. Spectra are Hermitian matrices; real and imaginary cross-spectral components contain different information.
adaptation: Motivates preserving quadrature/phase information. We use a per-window analytic-signal covariance projected to complex structure, with real SPD packing. This is not the review's wavelet/spectral-estimation pipeline.

title: Intrinsic Wavelet Regression for Curves of Hermitian Positive Definite Matrices
verified_mechanism: Constructs intrinsic wavelet regression for Hermitian positive definite matrix curves, including multivariate Fourier spectral estimation with guaranteed positive definiteness. Journal version JASA 116(534), 819–832, DOI 10.1080/01621459.2019.1700129.
adaptation: A literature alternative for future spectral curves. Full frequency-dependent intrinsic smoothing is excluded now because compressing it to one fixed R requires additional modeling choices. Our quadrature candidate does not implement this estimator.

title: Kernels for Sequentially Ordered Data
verified_mechanism: Builds positive-definite kernels for ordered sequences from signature/ordered-moment features and connects discrete sequences to continuous paths. JMLR 20(31), 1–45; verified arXiv ID 1601.08169.
adaptation: Supports ordered-path features and explicit interpolation. We compute exact depth-2 time-augmented signatures locally and add their channel Gram to original covariance. Full-kernel universality does not imply universality of our truncated, packed adaptation.

authors: Joel Dyer; Patrick W. Cannon; Sebastian M. Schmon
title: Amortised Likelihood-free Inference for Expensive Time-series Simulators with Signatured Ratio Estimation
verified_mechanism: Uses signatures of time-series paths in simulator-based inference and explains continuous piecewise-linear interpolation, iterated integrals and signature kernels.
adaptation: Provides a non-EEG application of path-based features. Our continuous covariance quadrature and signature-covariance fusion are new per-window assemblies; the paper's ratio estimator is not implemented.
